work.description: Entire refined LF11712–12148 and 20 literal LF of outside context fully read, using split('\n') only. Actual Leo XII attribution is positively consistent with the source protocol and closing. CCXIII has full §§1–8 with Latin papal discussion and an expressly quoted Latin archiepiscopal decree LF11808–11961 followed by Italian decree LF11963–12020; current papal narration/disposition resumes LF12022, with complete 25 May 1827 dating LF12145–12148. Native leaf85 right continues leaf86 left LF11777, then right LF11842; leaf87 left LF11915 continues right LF11980 (distintivo...), leaf88 left LF12055 continues right LF12124 (apo-/stolica). All own source apparatus and inserted decree closings remain; these decrees are integral quoted evidentiary text, not separately counted papal acts. Header LF11771 within the complete witness specifically identifies LeoXII. The source uses conventional In fede ec. at LF12018; it remains literal. The substantial inserted Italian decree is retained and the witness is classified mul. Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
